verdict.rationale: Postmark documents its own event-driven mechanisms: configurable real-time webhooks (delivery, bounce) that fire automatically on email events, and inbound blocking rules that act on incoming messages. There is no general rule engine for defining conditions and actions; any real action beyond the HTTP callback or the block has to be built by the user. Missing for 10: a user-definable condition→action rules engine, a choice of actions beyond webhook POSTs and inbound blocking, detailed docs on rule configuration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
